boundary.what_this_is_not: This is a LOCAL live-stack receipt. It is not evidence of a hosted environment, an external beta, real-money settlement, clinical use, or public launch. Those gates are audited in the product repo at docs/evidence/styx-launch-gates.md and remain open.

repairs_landed.defect: The launcher's readiness probe used bare curl, which inherits $CURL_HOME/.curlrc. An --http2 line there makes curl request an h2c upgrade on plain HTTP that Next answers by closing the connection, so a healthy stack reported 'web tour did not become ready'.
repairs_landed.why_ci_missed_it: Browsers and Playwright never attempt h2c over cleartext, so every browser check stayed green while the local launcher failed.

repairs_landed.defect: scripts/dev/run-api.mjs spawns the Nest server as a child and never forwarded signals, so a failed launch reparented a live API to init while it kept the API port. The next launch's readiness probe could then pass against a stale server bound to a database the reset in between had already dropped.
repairs_landed.fix: signals are forwarded, and cleanup waits for the process tree to die instead of firing and exiting
